You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import Counter as C2
def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);bg=C2(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==bg: continue
            if c>0 and g[r][c-1]==v: out[r][c]=v               # keeps its place
            elif c+1<W: out[r][c+1]=v                           # moves right 1
    return out
for key in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    i=G[key+' input']; o=G[key+' output']
    p=solve(i)
    nd=sum(1 for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if p[r][c]!=o[r][c])
    print(key,'ndiff',nd,'EXACT' if nd==0 else '')

from collections import Counter as C2, deque
def comps4(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);seen=set();out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                v=g[r][c];q=deque([(r,c)]);cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft()
                    cells.append((a,b))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y));q.append((x,y))
                out.append((v,sorted(cells)))
    return out

from collections import Counter
def f_domino(g):
    H=len(g);W=max(map(len,g))
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        # scan left to right; left neighbor in current (already-updated) row
        cur=[bg]*W
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            mv = v and ((c-1)<0 or cur[c-1]==bg)
            mv = mv and (c+1<W)
            if mv:
                cur[c+1]=v
            else:

        out[r]=cur
    return out

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=max(map(len,g))
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    p=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for v,cells in comps(g,bg):
        bottom_rows=[r for r,c in cells if r==max(r for r,c in cells)]
        right_cols=[c for c in set(c for r,c in cells if r==max(r for r2,c2 in cells if True) for r,c in cells)]
        # actually: bottom = max row; check all bottom-row cells have col == bbox max col
        mr=max(r for r,c in cells); mc=max(c for r,c in cells)
        moved = len(cells)==1 or all(c==mc for r,c in cells if r==mr)
        sh=(min(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells))
        for r,c in cells:
            dr,dc=(sh),()
            rr,cc=r-sh[0],c-sh[1]
            tgt=(r+dr[0]+0, c+dr[1]+0) if (dr[0]==dr[1]==0 and False) else None
        for r,c in cells:
            tr,tc=r+(0,1)[0],c+(0,1)[1]
            p[r][c]=v
        if moved:
            for r,c in cells:
                p[r][c+1]=v
    return p

def comps(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=max(map(len,g));seen=set();out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                v=g[r][c];q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c));cells=set()

from collections import Counter, defaultdict as dd
def comps(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=max(map(len,g));seen=set();out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                v=g[r][c];q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c));cells=set()
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop();cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==v and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx));q.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((v,frozenset(cells)))
    return out
# Hypothesis H: per color, group identical normalized shapes; in each group, keep only TOPMOST object (min row-min col), shift it right by 1; everything else unchanged.
def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=max(map(len,g))
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    groups=dd(list)
    for v,cl in cs:
        rs=[r for r,c in cl]; cc=[c for r,c in cl]
        mn=min(rs),min(cc)
        sh=tuple(sorted((r-mn[0],c-mn[1]) for r,c in cl))
        key=(v,sh)
        groups[key].append(cl)
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for (v,sh),ms in groups.items():
        if len(ms)>1:
            ms.sort(key=lambda cl:(min(r for r,c in cl),min(c for r,c in cl)))
            mover=min(ms)   # topmost kept and shifted
            for r,c in mover: out[r][c]=v
            for r,c in {(r,c+1) for r,c in mover}: out[r][c]=v
        else:
            for r,c in ms[0]: out[r][c]=v
    return out
allok=True
for d in range(1,9):
    i,o=G['Demo pair %d input'%d],G['Demo pair %d output'%d]
    p=f(i)
    nd=sum(p[a][b]!=o[a][b] for a in range(len(o)) for b in range(max(len(row) for row in o)))
    allok&=nd==0
    print('demo%d ndiff=%d'%(d,nd))
print('ALL EXACT' if allok else 'FAIL')
T=G['Test input']; pr=f(T)
